title: NATURE: Natural Auxiliary Text Utterances for Realistic Spoken Language Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness by applying the NATURE framework to perturb standard evaluation sets with human spoken language variations (e.g., conversational fillers, synonyms, and slips of the tongue/mispronunciations) to test if intent detection and slot-filling models over-rely on the surface-level heuristics and artifacts of clean written text.
